It uses Nathan Rothschild as a historical case study to show how he intentionally used early information and public panic during the Battle of Waterloo to quietly buy up the London stock exchange for pennies. The elite never announce their true moves to the public because they need the masses to act as their exit liquidity. Hearing a billionaire openly admit that investment advisors mislead clients just proves the point perfectly. After reading that book I completely stopped listening to mainstream market news and started focusing entirely on what the smart money is quietly doing in the background.
